verdict.rationale: Sierra is a SaaS agent platform, so full data export and portability is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no export feature, open-format download, or offboarding path. Writing journeys as code in the Agent SDK and holding GDPR certification are related but different capabilities, and neither shows that a user can export all of their data and leave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
